note: Exploratory. The target is the size of the monthly difference between a model anomaly and a station anomaly. A larger difference does not say which of the two is right, and nothing here shows cause and effect.

methods.target: absolute value of (model anomaly minus station anomaly) for each month, in three classes (small, medium, large) cut at the 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of the training rows of all pairs together; the test rows use the same cut points
methods.features: calendar month; model product; GLDAS segment number (GLDAS pairs only, 0 for MERRA-2 pairs; segments start at the documented step months of gldas_tair); station (one-hot, not used when a station is held out); the state (-1 low, 0 normal, 1 high) of the detrended anomaly of each non-temperature variable at the nearest core point in the same month; the state of the station's own anomaly
methods.not_used: the model anomaly, the station anomaly and their difference as numbers; temperature variables (same quantity as the target); the pair's own class of the previous month (used only in the variant with_target_lag); power_t2m (it serves MERRA-2 fields)
methods.walk_forward: months in time order; the first tree_min_train_months months are training only, the rest is cut into tree_n_folds test folds; each fold trains on all earlier months. Calendar-month means, linear trends and all cut points are estimated from the training months only
methods.leave_one_location_out: train on the other stations, test on the held-out station; training and test rows cover the same months, so this checks a new place, not the future. Each series is centred and cut on its own full record; the target cut points use the training stations
methods.baselines: train_majority: always the most frequent class of the training rows; persistence: the pair's class of the previous month; calendar_month: the most frequent training class of that calendar month. hindsight_test_majority is known only after the test period and is not counted in above_all_baselines
methods.descriptive: mean absolute difference by group with a 95% interval from a bootstrap that resamples whole calendar years; anomalies are the ones in model_vs_obs.json (monthly climatology of the common months)

leakage_guards: feature names are checked: components of the target, temperature variables and the target's own lag are rejected
any single feature that classifies more than max_single_feature_accuracy of the training rows on its own stops the run
walk-forward folds re-estimate centring, trend and cut points from the training months only

with_segment.note: Main run: includes the GLDAS segment number, no previous-month target.

summary.text_en: The tree's test accuracy is above all three baselines in 0 of 3 folds (above the training-majority guess in 1, above the previous-month persistence guess in 0, above the calendar-month guess in 1). In 3 of 3 folds the tree does not beat at least one guess that uses no other variable.

The tree's test accuracy is above all three baselines in 1 of 6 held-out stations (above the training-majority guess in 5, above the previous-month persistence guess in 1, above the calendar-month guess in 5). In 5 of 6 held-out stations the tree does not beat at least one guess that uses no other variable.
